metadata.methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded before and six months after administration of either Neuroepo (n=15) or placebo (n=10). Qualitative EEG analysis was performed by two experts using a Likert-type scale and multivariate item response theory (MIRT). Quantitative EEG analysis was conducted at the source level using VARETA software with co-registration to the Montreal Neurological Institute Atlas. Statistical comparisons between groups and timepoints were performed using permutation tests and contrast methods with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.
